combo1.title: Doom-Z Full Combo Line
combo1.description: Going first from DoomZ V Five - Amalthe and Mulcharmy Fuwalos, transcribed move by move from a recorded duel. Amalthe finds Drastea, and Drastea climbs through DoomZ XII End - Drastrius into DoomZ XIII Over - Graflareio. Raiders and Graflareio's floating effect bring out Elara, DoomZ Change and Jupredo, and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. sends Jupredo face-up to the Extra Deck for Terminus. Elara and Amalthe become Springans Merrymaker and then Gigantic "Champion" Sargas, which adds Therion "King" Regulus. Terminus, Vidolium and Vidolia bring out Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction, and DoomZ Change and DoomZ Destruction finish the board. You pass with Sargas, Regulus, Jupiter, a Drastea holding D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G. and Jupredo, DoomZ Raiders and Vidolia face-up, DoomZ Destruction Set and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. in hand.

combo2.title: Beyond the Brave: Citrinitas Finds Medius (1 Card)
combo2.description: Going first from one card. Ars Magna "Citrinitas" is always treated as a DoomZ card, and its search adds Medius the Pure. Medius calls Power Patron DoomZ, which turns Medius into DoomZ Break - Diactorus and equips itself to it. Diactorus destroys that Equip Spell, Power Patron DoomZ adds Drastea, and Drastea destroys the spent Citrinitas to Special Summon itself with D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G. You pass with Diactorus and a Drastea your opponent can't target, ready to become DoomZ XII End - Drastrius on their turn.

combo3.title: Beyond the Brave: Jupredo and Theorealized Medius, Normal Summon Spare
combo3.description: Going first with two cards and without your Normal Summon. Jupredo in the Pendulum Zone is the Power Patron card Theorealized Medius needs, and it counts as the DoomZ card that Theorealize Past Lull needs. Past Lull calls Medius the Pure, whose Power Patron DoomZ makes DoomZ Break - Diactorus. Diactorus destroys Jupredo, which adds DoomZ Raiders once it is face-up in the Extra Deck. Raiders and Power Patron DoomZ fetch Drastea and DoomZ Destruction. You pass with Drastea and D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G., Raiders face-up, Destruction Set, A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. in the GY and Theorealized Medius waiting for a face-up banish.

combo4.title: Beyond the Brave: Mediclius Beside Drastea (No Raiders)
combo4.description: Going first with Medius the Pure and Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification. The Corruption and the Purification banishes itself for Citrinitas and comes back when DoomZ Break - Diactorus is Xyz Summoned. Citrinitas adds Theorealized Medius. The line never activates DoomZ Raiders, and Power Patron DoomZ's lock ends when it becomes an Equip Spell, so Diactorus, the Corruption and the Purification and Theorealized Medius can become Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron. Past Lull puts a second Medius the Pure in a zone it points to. You pass with Mediclius, which is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects while it points to 2 monsters, and Drastea with D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G.
